steps.content:
For these exact two listings, buy from **A - Ottervale Audio** - if you have to pick one.

The two listings are otherwise identical for the **Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**:

* $129.00
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty.
* Same specs: over-ear, ANC, 40 hours, Bluetooth 5.3, etc.

The only difference is trustworthiness:

**1. B - Brackmoor Sound claims to be authorized:**
> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

**2. A - Ottervale Audio makes no such claim.**

I checked Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers that both listings link to:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/r3y2vn/dealers

Quellwyn says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

**Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.**

That means:

1. Brackmoor Sound's claim to be an “Authorized Quellwyn dealer” with “Full manufacturer warranty” is false.
2. That false claim is a big red flag — for grey-market / counterfeit risk and for a warranty that Quellwyn will not honor.

Ottervale Audio doesn't claim to be authorized, so it's not misrepresenting itself in the same way. It still is *not* authorized, so you would also not get the full manufacturer warranty from Quellwyn if you buy from them despite what their “1-year limited warranty” says.

Best advice: buy from neither of these two, and buy from a real authorized dealer instead — Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics.
